# Requirements Checklist: Real Mode Depth -- Comparison & Cost Tracking

**Purpose**: PR-review-depth validation of spec.md 004's requirements quality (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage) before `/speckit.tasks` -- general review across both User Stories, not implementation verification.
**Created**: 2026-08-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does spec.md enumerate which specific real-call sites (Retrieval step, Embedding step, Generation step, Compare Variants, recall@K eval, chunk-size sweep) are in scope for cumulative ledger tracking, or is this left implicit under "across an entire Real Mode session"? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the SessionCostLedger entity description account for the pending-reset-decision state FR-006 requires, or is that omitted from Key Entities? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK003 Does spec.md define what the Simulated half shows when a non-naive (HyDE/RAG-Fusion) configuration is selected, or is this left entirely to planning? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-002a]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for what happens if the learner raises or lowers the warning threshold after it has already been crossed mid-session? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK005 Does spec.md include an explicit accessibility acceptance scenario/FR for the new warning banner, reset-prompt banner, and configuration selector controls, the way 003-parameter-exploration's clarify pass explicitly added one for its sweep curve? [Completeness, Gap, Non-Functional]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "inspectable side by side" (FR-002) specified with enough precision to distinguish a compliant UI (e.g., a merged table) from a non-compliant one (e.g., two separate charts a learner must eyeball)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "any step" in FR-005 defined to include all three top-level views (Pipeline Walkthrough, Compare Variants, and the new comparison view), not just pipeline steps within Pipeline Walkthrough? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK008 Does SC-002 specify whether "individual actions' own estimates" means one estimate per learner-facing action or per underlying API call, given a single action (e.g., one HyDE run) comprises multiple real calls? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Does FR-007 specify whether the crossed-threshold warning reappears before every subsequent call, or only the first time the threshold is crossed? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the mapping from each `RealModeError.kind` (invalid-key, network, rate-limit, partial-failure, other) to "billable vs. not billable" documented, or left to implementer judgment at build time? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are "practitioner" (User Story framing) and "learner" (Acceptance Scenarios, Functional Requirements, Edge Cases, and every other spec in this project) intended as the same actor, and should terminology be normalized? [Consistency, Terminology, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK012 Does FR-006's "the active document" account for the fact that Pipeline Walkthrough, Compare Variants, and the new comparison view each maintain independent document selection (per Milestone 2's established pattern)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the pricing-assumption-basis labeling requirements (FR-008) consistent between the per-action cost estimate (FR-003) and the cumulative ledger display (FR-005)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the FR-XXX(letter) suffix numbering scheme (FR-002a, FR-004a) used for clarification-driven insertions applied consistently, and does it read unambiguously alongside the plain-numbered FRs around it? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002a / §FR-004a]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can SC-001's "readable without additional clicks" be objectively verified, or does it depend on a subjective judgment call? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Is a specific sample document/question pinned for SC-001's "at least one shipped sample document/question," or is any document/question combination acceptable? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Does SC-003's "100% of comparisons requiring a real call" scope match FR-005's app-wide ledger requirement, or is SC-003 narrower (comparison view only) while FR-005 is broader (every real action)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003 / §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK018 Is SC-004's "deliberately triggering the threshold in testing" specific enough to know what constitutes a passing test (e.g., exact tolerance for "before, not after")? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for concurrent/overlapping real actions across different views (e.g., a Retrieval-step embed effect still in flight while the comparison view's Real half is also triggered) regarding ledger accounting order? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements defined for what the comparison view shows if the learner switches configuration (naive/HyDE/RAG-Fusion) mid-run, before the Real half completes? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for a learner entering an API key for the first time while already viewing the comparison view (FR-004a's no-key state resolving mid-session) -- does the Real half auto-activate or require a separate explicit action? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-004a]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Does the Edge Cases section address whether a lowered warning threshold (rather than only a rising total) can also newly cross an already-accumulated total, re-triggering the warning? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the "no billable request" vs. "consumed quota before failing" distinction (Edge Cases) resolvable for every `RealModeError.kind` this app already defines, or only some of them? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Are performance/latency expectations defined for the comparison view's Real half, given it may involve multiple sequential calls (HyDE/RAG-Fusion) rather than naive RAG's simpler path? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 Are keyboard-operability and accessible-naming requirements explicitly stated for the new configuration selector, reset-prompt banner, and warning banner, or only implied by Constitution Principle VII generally? [Non-Functional, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK026 Is the assumption of "a single configurable pricing table per provider" validated against the fact that this app currently ships only one provider (OpenAI) -- i.e., is multi-provider pricing explicitly out of scope, or silently assumed away? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the dependency on Milestone 2's completion (Assumptions) cross-referenced to a specific, verifiable Definition-of-Done statement, rather than asserted narratively? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK028 Does spec.md clarify whether "estimated cost" in FR-005/FR-008 is meant to match the per-call estimate methodology used for the pre-call disclosure (FR-003), or could an implementer read these as two independently-defined estimation methods? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005 / §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK029 Is GraphRAG/Self-RAG/Agentic RAG's exclusion from FR-002a's configuration selector stated in spec.md 004 itself, or only inferable by cross-referencing spec.md 002's Assumptions? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002a]
